Description: Pipeline-generated unique record identifier.
Notes: Stable only within this release unless key logic remains unchanged.

Description: USC ADRC UDS/PTID-style participant identifier as represented in source files.
Notes: No participant names are included in release outputs.

Description: Best source date used to place the specimen record longitudinally.
Notes: Do not assume every specimen_date is a draw date; inspect specimen_date_type.

Description: Meaning of specimen_date in the source.
Notes: collection_date for BST; source_date_labeled_received for NCRAD current.

Description: Explicit collection/draw date when available; otherwise missing.
Notes: Preferred for analyses requiring true collection timing.

Description: Explicit received date when available.
Notes: May be identical to collection date for same-day receipt.

Description: Normalized component code: plasma, buffy_coat, serum, or csf.
Notes: Component types are not collapsed into a generic biofluid category.

Description: Human-readable component label.
Notes: Convenience label only.

Description: Positive source-reported number of aliquots/tubes for this component.
Notes: Do not interpret as mL unless aliquot_volume_ml is populated.

Description: Per-aliquot volume in mL only when explicitly defined by the source header.
Notes: Legacy BST rows generally do not specify per-aliquot volume.

Description: Normalized source-reported storage box/location.
Notes: Formatting such as 'Box ' is normalized away.

Description: Source-reported study when available.
Notes: Not available in all historical sources.

Description: Source supplying the released record-level detail after source reconciliation.
Notes: Use when source context is relevant to interpretation.

Description: Whether matching current NCRAD documentation also supports the released record.
Notes: Corroboration does not imply an independent collection.

Description: Number of integrated primary-source records supporting the released record.
Notes: Currently 1 or 2 for integrated primary sources.

Description: Interpretation note for the specimen date field.
Notes: Use this field when date semantics matter.
